storyCards.fact:
Ellie Goulding's "Burn" reached #13 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Burn" is a song by English singer Ellie Goulding from Halcyon Days (2013), the reissue of her second studio album, Halcyon (2012).

The song peaked at #13 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 36 weeks on the chart.

Burn was released in 2013.
